## AuraView v0.3.5

### Video download fixes
- Download the selected video from Instagram carousel posts when its player can be matched to the post's media.
- Keep the video download button visible while preparing and keep format options open when clicking outside.

### Windows installers
Choose the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** below. Both install AuraView v0.3.5 for Windows x64 and bundle the configured video download tools and ad-blocking resources.

> Note: The installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning.
